chunks: And what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān, who said:

I sent a question to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام with Ibrāhīm ibn Maymūn. I said: Ask him about a man who urinates, and a spot the size of a speck from his urine reaches his thigh, then he performs salat (prayer), and afterward remembers that he had not washed it. He said: He should wash it and repeat his salat (prayer).

key_terms.صَلَاتَهُ: his ritual prayer which must be repeated
key_terms.مَسْأَلَةً: a legal question submitted for ruling
key_terms.نُكْتَةٍ: a tiny spot or speck-sized amount

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone remembers after salat (prayer) that urine had remained on his body?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about najasah affecting the validity of salat (prayer). If a person prays while a trace of urine remains on his body and later remembers that he did not wash it, he must wash the impurity and repeat the prayer.
